headline: Documentation covers a single in-progress task to produce business and detailed design documents from the existing source code, and the code review could not confirm its state either way.
what_is_there: The only item in this area is a deliverable to write business design and detailed design documentation derived from the current system. What the analysis found nearby related to agent security and sandboxing rules rather than design documentation.
what_is_unclear: Whether any of the design documentation has actually been drafted could not be established, largely because a documentation deliverable leaves no code trace and one document that surfaced was explicitly noted as belonging to a different system.
suggested_action: Ask the ticket owner to point to where the business and detailed design documents live, or to share a current draft, so progress can be tracked outside the codebase.
